en_quote: Risk-based account closure: Based on reporting obligations, the organization might need approval to offboard customers due to suspected illicit activity or noncompliance risks.
knowledge_zh: 因涉嫌非法活动或不合规风险而终止客户关系需获得批准

en_quote: Exits based on a mismatch in risk appetite should be reviewed and decided on a caseby-case basis.
knowledge_zh: 因风险偏好不匹配导致的客户退出应逐案审查决定

en_quote: By implementing dynamic, risk-based measures and leveraging advanced technologies, financial institutions enhance AFC controls and align with international AFC obligations.
knowledge_zh: 动态风险措施和先进技术增强金融犯罪防控并符合国际义务
